mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_ai_config (user_id, ai_enabled, disabled_reason, disabled_by, max_daily_queries, blocked_agents) VALUES (#{userId}, #{aiEnabled}, #{disabledReason}, #{disabledBy}, #{maxDailyQueries}, #{blockedAgents})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_user_ai_config SET ai_enabled = #{aiEnabled}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, disabled_by = #{disabledBy}, max_daily_queries = #{maxDailyQueries}, blocked_agents = #{blockedAgents}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE ai_user_ai_config SET ai_enabled = #{aiEnabled}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, disabled_by = #{disabledBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, ai_enabled, disabled_reason, disabled_by, max_daily_queries, blocked_agents, create_time, update_time FROM ai_user_ai_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
